INSERT INTO miner_identity ("payoutId", kind, address, "createdAt", "updatedAt")
           VALUES ($1, 'static', $1, $2, $2)
           ON CONFLICT ("payoutId") DO UPDATE SET
             kind = 'static',
             address = EXCLUDED.address,
             descriptor = NULL,
             "updatedAt" = EXCLUDED."updatedAt"
